description.value: The Assiniboine Creek Trail is a backcountry trail within Mount Assiniboine Provincial Park, part of the Canadian Rocky Mountain Parks UNESCO World Heritage Site. The park is celebrated for its alpine lakes, glaciers, and dramatic peaks, with no road access — trails provide the only way in. It is a remote wilderness destination requiring full self-sufficiency, suited to experienced backcountry travellers.
